hooks.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$envPath=Join-Path $HOME '.config\codex-honcho-sync\.env'; Get-Content $envPath | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*[^#][^=]*=' } | ForEach-Object { $name,$value=$_.Split('=',2); Set-Item -Path ('env:'+$name.Trim()) -Value $value.Trim() }; & $env:CODEX_HONCHO_NODE (Join-Path $env:CODEX_HONCHO_SYNC_ROOT 'scripts\codex_honcho_turn_gate.mjs')"
